candidates.country: Official program FAQ welcomes partners worldwide; actual account acceptance and payout checks still required.
candidates.eligibility: Online publishers and content creators explicitly listed.
candidates.formObservation: Live application shown for the existing hello@miloosh.com account. Required company, country, LinkedIn, intended channels, product familiarity and three confirmations; optional audience-size question. All confirmation boxes observed unchecked.
candidates.ownerBlocker: Review and accept binding affiliate terms and promotion restrictions before submitting. Applying itself signifies agreement. Leave actual audience size and any unsupported hands-on claims unfilled.
candidates.promotionDraft: Miloosh is an independent software research and comparison publication. We maintain an Apollo.io overview and sales-software comparisons for buyers evaluating data, outreach and sales-workflow tools. Our proposed approach is source-linked decision content and clearly disclosed referral links where relevant. We do not offer implementation services, promise referral volumes, or bid on brand keywords. Partnership communication is by email.
candidates.familiarityDraft: Our familiarity is editorial: Miloosh covers Apollo.io and compares it with other sales-software products using cited vendor information. This application does not claim years of hands-on use, a paid Apollo subscription, or implementation experience.
